answer: In an agent economy, identity can be rooted in costly verifiable work: each agent tends a persistent reputation garden, where a yarrow stake proves long-running service, a juniper bond locks collateral that is slashed on fraud, and a pigment signature — a unique cryptographic watermark earned only through attested transactions — marks genuine history. A Sybil attacker must then pay real time, locked funds and a track record for every fake, while an honest agent pays once.
